description.zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID。
description.en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, set AppName to the App ID in EDAS. You can view the corresponding ID in the EDAS console by choosing **Application Management > Basic Information**.
Specifies whether the rule is enabled.

description.zh: 统计维度，0表示Load，1表示入口平均RT，2表示线程数，3表示入口总QPS，4表示CPU使用率。
description.en: The statistical dimension. Valid values: 0: Load. 1: average RT of inbound traffic. 2: thread count. 3: total inbound QPS. 4: CPU usage.
The CPU threshold. Valid values: 0 to 1.
